pages.text: Nearly everything here has a button as well (ESC opens the hub: see $(l:lemursaucepacket:esc-menu)The ESC menu$(/l)), but commands are quicker once you know them. Type them in chat: press $(bold)T$(), or $(bold)/$() to start with the slash.

pages.title: You and your progress
pages.text: $(#b9a98a)Command - What it does$()$(br)$(bold)$(#e0ac46)/hiscores$()$() - The hiscores: everyone ranked by total level. $(l:lemursaucepacket:hiscores)More$(/l)$(br)$(bold)$(#e0ac46)/hiscores skills$()$() - Every skill's table to click (also $(#e0ac46)bosses$(), $(#e0ac46)activities$(), $(#e0ac46)collections$())$(br)$(bold)$(#e0ac46)/hiscores mining$()$() - One table: any skill, boss, activity or collection by name$(br)$(bold)$(#e0ac46)/hiscores player <name>$()$() - Someone's hiscores: every skill, boss, activity and collection

$(bold)$(#e0ac46)/capes$()$() - Your cape collection: what you have, how to earn the rest. $(l:lemursaucepacket:capes)More$(/l)$(br)$(bold)$(#e0ac46)/capes wear <cape>$()$() - Put on a cape from your bag$(br)$(bold)$(#e0ac46)/capes off$()$() - Take your cape off (it goes back in your bag)$(br)$(bold)$(#e0ac46)/hearts$()$() - Your hearts, and where each one came from. $(l:lemursaucepacket:lifesteal)More$(/l)$(br)$(bold)$(#e0ac46)/guide$()$() - Open the LemurSaucePacket Guide, this wiki as a book

$(bold)$(#e0ac46)/skills$()$() - The skills screen: every skill and your level. $(l:lemursaucepacket:skills)More$(/l)$(br)$(bold)$(#e0ac46)/skills <skill>$()$() - That skill's guide: what every level unlocks$(br)$(bold)$(#e0ac46)/fallingtree toggle$()$() - Switch the Lumber Axe's whole-tree felling off or on for yourself

pages.title: Coins and trading
pages.text: $(#b9a98a)Command - What it does$()$(br)$(bold)$(#e0ac46)/purse$()$() - How many Gold Coins you're carrying. $(l:lemursaucepacket:economy)More$(/l)$(br)$(bold)$(#e0ac46)/worth$()$() - What a vendor would pay for the item in your hand$(br)$(bold)$(#e0ac46)/trade <player>$()$() - Ask someone to trade (or sneak and right-click them with an empty hand). $(l:lemursaucepacket:economy)More$(/l)$(br)$(bold)$(#e0ac46)/palette buy$()$() - Buy another Mason's Palette when you've lost yours (Construction 99, 10,000 coins). $(l:lemursaucepacket:skills)More$(/l)

pages.title: Lifesteal
pages.text: $(#b9a98a)Command - What it does$()$(br)$(bold)$(#e0ac46)/revive <player>$()$() - Bring an eliminated player back, using the Heart in your hand. $(l:lemursaucepacket:lifesteal)More$(/l)$(br2)There are no teleport commands: travel is by $(l:lemursaucepacket:waystones)waystones$(/l), trains, airships, horses and happy ghasts. Admins have more commands (under $(#e0ac46)/lsp$()), which aren't listed here.

pages.title: Handy vanilla ones
pages.text: $(#b9a98a)Command - What it does$()$(br)$(bold)$(#e0ac46)/msg <player> <message>$()$() - A private message (also $(#e0ac46)/tell$() and $(#e0ac46)/w$())$(br)$(bold)$(#e0ac46)/me <action>$()$() - Say what you're doing, in the third person$(br)$(bold)$(#e0ac46)/seed$()$() - Not allowed here: the world's seed is the server's secret
